name: Human-curated topic map of people and sources

mentions.name: Human-curated topic map of people and sources
mentions.description: A human-curated map that organizes people and sources by topics such as health, skills, business, and mindset. All categorization is done manually with no AI classification. It started as spreadsheets and is now being turned into a prototype.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a human-curated map that organizes people and sources by topics (health, skills, business, mindset, etc.). Everything is categorized manually, no AI classification. Started as spreadsheets and now turning it into a prototype.
